core.title: Public kiosk
core.guidance: Attract screen → hub of large tiles → linear flows with one giant primary action, ≥60 px targets in the reach zone, ≥20 px text with high contrast for glare, brand colour on header and primary action, filled icons with labels, idle timeout with countdown, cancel always visible, audio/visual feedback. Identity via tile geometry, illustration, and the brand colour field.

core.title: Filled icons for distance and touch
core.guidance: Filled or bold-weight set at ≥24 dp (≥32 dp on TV), always with a visible label in navigation, filled/outline swap allowed only to show selection.
core.use_when: TV, kiosks, and touch UI where icons must read at a glance and at distance; selected states in tab bars (filled = selected).
core.avoid_when: Dense desktop UI where filled icons become heavy blobs.

core.title: Touch-only focus handling (mobile)
core.guidance: Pressed state within 100 ms (ripple/opacity/scale), 44 pt / 48 dp targets, screen-reader focus order = visual order, and platform focus visuals left enabled for keyboard/switch users (do not disable). Kiosks: larger targets (≥ 60 px) and no hover-dependent affordances.
core.use_when: Native mobile and kiosk apps where there is no persistent keyboard focus; feedback is pressed state + screen-reader focus provided by the platform.
core.avoid_when: Any app that supports hardware keyboards, external pointers (iPadOS, Android desktop mode), or switch access without testing them.

guardrails.title: Saving, saved, autosave, session expiry, and permission-denied states
guardrails.guidance: Show saving → saved as a quiet inline status with a timestamp (not a toast per keystroke); autosave drafts and say so; warn before a session expires with a way to extend, and never discard entered data on expiry (restore the draft after re-authentication); permission-denied is a designed state that explains what is missing and who can grant it rather than an empty screen; destructive or irreversible saves confirm once with the safe action as default.
guardrails.use_when: Forms and editors longer than a minute, multi-step flows, authenticated sessions with timeouts, screens whose data depends on permissions.
guardrails.avoid_when: Trivial one-field actions that complete instantly.
guardrails.selected_for: required concern states: every screen ships empty/loading/error states

guardrails.title: Kiosk: public, hurried, standing users
guardrails.guidance: Targets ≥60 px, body text ≥20 px, high contrast for glare, one task per screen, reachable-height controls (ADA reach ranges: interactive elements within 380–1220 mm), idle timeout with countdown that clears the session, attract screen as the hub, audio/visual feedback on every tap, and a visible way to cancel at every step.
guardrails.use_when: Self-service, POS, check-in, ticketing, signage with touch.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never require hover, precise dragging, small text, or scrolling to find the primary action; never keep personal data on screen after inactivity.
guardrails.selected_for: required concern environment: public kiosk use

guardrails.title: Users always know where they are and how to go back
guardrails.guidance: Current location marked (aria-current, selected tab, breadcrumb, page title); URL/route reflects state on web and deep-linkable screens; back returns to the previous screen with its scroll and selection; titles match the navigation label that led there.
guardrails.use_when: Every navigation model; deep links; multi-step flows; tabs that hold stacks.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never break the browser/system back; never use a single URL for many states on the web.
guardrails.selected_for: recommended concern navigation: how users arrive and leave
